lifecycle_stages.description: Local product package built, zero dependencies verified, unit and customer tests 100% PASS, adversarial attacks survived, launch package assembled and hashed.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: All tests, checksums, and package artifacts present and verified on Windows host.

lifecycle_stages.description: Human operator (Chief / Product Owner) formally signs launch approval card.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Operator signature file exists with valid non-null timestamp and explicit approval flag.

lifecycle_stages.description: Listing is publicly available on primary channel at a valid URL, visible without credentials.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Unauthenticated HTTP GET on public_url returns status 200 with matching title and price €5.00.

lifecycle_stages.description: At least one external visitor or referral has navigated to the public listing.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Public visit count >= 1 recorded in platform analytics or access log.

lifecycle_stages.description: A customer initiates checkout on the platform.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Checkout event recorded with cart total >= €5.00.

lifecycle_stages.description: Transaction settles successfully with a valid receipt and payment confirmation ID.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Verified gross_amount_eur >= €5.00 with unique order identifier and zero chargeback/refund flags.

lifecycle_stages.description: Funds are cleared in the Merchant of Record balance, ready for bank payout.
lifecycle_stages.validation_rule: Cleared balance shows net positive revenue >= €4.00 (gross €5.00 minus platform fee).
